Social Media Manager
position_overview:
Kaseya is seeking a highly skilled and creative Social Media Manager with at least five years of B2B social media experience to add to its global marketing communications team. This role is ideal for an experienced social media leader with deep B2B experience who can balance strategy, execution, and mentorship while helping to elevate brand reputation across Kaseya and its portfolio of brands. 

 A successful social media manager at Kaseya will be able to collaborate, coordinate, and drive online engagement strategies that build the positive reputation of the Kaseya family of brands globally as well as work on corporate communications initiatives to drive customer awareness and positive sentiment about Kaseya’s vision, strategy, competitive differentiation and market momentum. 

 The position requires an understanding of social media best practices, and a desire to research and explore new strategies. As a key member of the global marketing communications team, the social media manager will be responsible for collaborating and executing on social media marketing strategies, video and image creation to support specific initiatives, reporting on metrics, and monitoring and managing brand reputation in social communities.

About Kaseya 

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya has built a culture centered around innovation, accountability, and results. We are a high-growth, high-performance organization that values individuals who are driven, adaptable, and committed to delivering exceptional outcomes for our customers and teammates alike.
